mainEntity.name: Do you have references I can speak to, especially in my specialty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we'd be glad to connect you with a practice similar to yours so you can hear directly from someone who's already been through the switch, just book a demo and ask for a reference call. You can also browse our customer stories and filter by specialty (physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech, pediatric, and chiropractic) to find practices like yours.

mainEntity.name: Do you have testimonials specifically about the billing side?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. Several of our customer stories focus specifically on billing and collections results, and you can filter the library by the Billing and RCM Services solutions to see more. If you'd like to hear it firsthand, just ask for a billing-focused reference during your demo and we'll set it up.

mainEntity.name: Can I contact a reference in my area / similar practice size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we're happy to connect you with a practice similar to yours, just book a demo and ask for a reference call. You can also browse our customer stories library, which you can filter by location (by state) and by practice size (from 1–9 clinicians up to 200+), so it's easy to find a match close to your size and region.

mainEntity.name: What results have other practices seen after switching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results vary by practice, but the stories we hear most often are gains in collections, revenue, documentation time, and capacity. What tends to drive those wins is consistent: our customers are working in fewer disconnected systems, doing less manual rework, and getting much better visibility into how their practice is performing. We're happy to connect you with a practice similar to yours so you can hear how it played out for them firsthand.

mainEntity.name: Have any large practices with big Accounts Receivable used Prompt successfully?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. One example we point to often is Arete Health, a 13-location, 40+ clinician practice that moved to our full-service RCM and increased collections by over 200%. On the RCM side, we're seeing outcomes like a 97% clean claim rate and a 99.85% net collection rate, with our team managing every step of billing for you, from claims to payment posting and AR follow-up. If it'd help, just ask for an enterprise or RCM reference during your demo and we'll connect you with a practice that's been in your shoes.
